dedupe_keys.name: fault detection and diagnosis web service module for energy monitoring in buildings

description: Melendez, Joaquim and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented model uses Multivariate Principal Component Analysis to detect and diagnose building-energy anomalies. It is integrated as a web service in the HIT2GAP environment and uses the separately deposited Challenger measurements. Its object is statistical deviation in energy behaviour and operational performance, not a claimed structural-damage detector. The method can support investigation of abnormal HVAC or building-consumption operation within the reported demonstration. Detailed thresholds, false-alarm rates and source-code distribution are not established by the metadata inspected. The linked raw observations retain their separate data identity. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
